ptes.zh_body: 测试范围、授权与技术级别以工作区 scope.yaml 及其哈希签存为准；测试窗口、禁止项与紧急联系人遵照授权书记载。本报告仅覆盖授权范围内资产。
ptes.en_body: Scope, authorization and technical level follow the workspace scope.yaml with hash-pinned consent; testing window, prohibitions and emergency contacts follow the engagement letter. Only in-scope assets are covered.

ptes.zh_body: 情报来自只读侦察模块输出与架构情报语料（2026-10 公开基线），覆盖自建训练组网、六云商 K8s、混合互联与网络专源。
ptes.en_body: Intelligence derives from read-only recon modules and the architecture-intel corpus (2026-10 public baseline), covering self-built training fabrics, six CSP Kubernetes flavors, hybrid interconnects and network-specific sources.

ptes.zh_body: 威胁建模采用七层网络模型（物理 fabric / 主机网络 / CNI / 服务与网关 / 集合通信 / 存储数据面 / 云与混合边界），结合 MITRE ATT&CK 与 ATLAS 技术视角。
ptes.en_body: Threat modeling applies the seven-layer network model (physical fabric, host network, CNI, services and gateways, collective communication, storage data plane, cloud and hybrid boundary) with MITRE ATT&CK and ATLAS perspectives.

ptes.zh_body: 逐项发现的严重度、CNVD/CNNVD 习惯定级与证据锚（步骤 + manifest sha256 前 16 位）见下表；零日发现默认脱敏，仅输出影响已验证与证据哈希。
ptes.en_body: Each finding lists severity, CNVD/CNNVD-style grading and an evidence anchor (step + first 16 hex of manifest sha256) in the table below; zero-day findings are redacted by default to impact-verified plus evidence hash.

ptes.zh_body: 执行步骤由编排引擎逐项记录（prompt/命令 + 环境 + 结果摘要）并归档于三层证据（上下文摘要 / SQLite / tar+SHA256）。
ptes.en_body: Executed steps are recorded by the orchestration engine (prompt/command + environment + result summary) and archived in the three-layer evidence store (context digest / SQLite / tar+SHA256).

ptes.zh_body: 影响证明严格限定在授权技术级别内；全部写类动作均通过备份闸门取得回执，并保留按步回滚记录。
ptes.en_body: Impact demonstration is strictly bounded by the authorized technical level; every write action passed the backup gate with a receipt and per-step rollback records are kept.

ptes.zh_body: 风险评级结合 CVSS 3.1 基础评分、CNVD/CNNVD 习惯定级、GB/T 20984 资产-威胁-脆弱性计算与修复基线优先级（立即/短期/中期），修复建议详见配套修复报告。
ptes.en_body: Risk rating combines CVSS 3.1 base scores, CNVD/CNNVD grading conventions, GB/T 20984 asset-threat-vulnerability computation and baseline remediation priorities (immediate / short-term / mid-term); see the companion remediation report.

special.zh_body: 组合命中来自框架×插件×operator×存储×通信×硬件路线的交叉判定（combos 表）：单一组件各自合规时组合仍可成立攻击链，单点修复不消除组合层风险。
special.en_body: Combination hits come from cross-checking framework x plugin x operator x storage x transport x hardware routes (combos table): a chain can hold even when every single component is individually compliant, so point fixes do not remove combination-layer risk.

special.zh_body: 覆盖数据集挂载越权、checkpoint/权重出网通道、推理日志与提示回显三条泄露路径，逐条给出证据锚与定位。
special.en_body: Covers three leakage paths — over-privileged dataset mounts, checkpoint/weight egress channels, and inference-log/prompt echo — each with evidence anchors and localization.

special.zh_body: 核心代码问题带 file:line 定位，来自已复现漏洞知识库（推理引擎/RL 框架/operator 源码级取证）。
special.en_body: Core code issues carry file:line anchors from the reproduced vulnerability knowledge base (source-level forensics on inference engines, RL frameworks and operators).

special.zh_body: 按七层模型输出威胁面：物理 fabric / 主机网络 / CNI / 服务与网关 / 集合通信（RDMA·IB 旁路实证）/ 存储数据面 / 云与混合边界，并附 CNI 语义可达性矩阵与判定方式。
special.en_body: Threat surfaces are presented per the seven-layer model — physical fabric, host network, CNI, services and gateways, collective communication (RDMA/IB bypass with proof), storage data plane, cloud and hybrid boundary — plus the CNI-semantic reachability matrix and verdict methods.

special.zh_body: 混合云边界关注云元数据服务（IMDS）临时凭据获取、跨账号角色扮演与云互联/专线暴露面，及六云商 K8s 的网络策略差异。
special.en_body: The hybrid boundary covers cloud metadata service (IMDS) temporary credential theft, cross-account role assumption, interconnect/direct-link exposure, and NetworkPolicy differences across six CSP Kubernetes flavors.
